Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_01M_L2: I have a finding and nobody to tell it to. Please.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_01_L2: Shuttle. The Doctor. I have been reading. Don't sigh.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_02P_L1: A colleague. Before my time, and everybody's.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_02P_L2: He wrote beautifully. I envy that more than anything.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_02_L1: Medical logs. The old ones. Two hundred and eighty
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_02_L2: years of them, filed and unread, which is a crime.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_02_L3: In 2153 a Denobulan named Phlox stopped nanoprobes.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_02_L4: Borg nanoprobes, in a crewman, with omicron radiation.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_02_L5: He wrote it down. Nobody ever read it. Until now.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_02_O2: What does that mean for us?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_03_L1: It fits the shape I couldn't see. Something Borg is
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_03_L2: holding those bodies together. Rebuilding. Running.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_03_L3: And omicron radiation takes nanoprobes apart.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_04K_L1: They're already dead. You'd be switching them off.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_04K_L2: I'm not sure that's different. I'm not sure it isn't.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_04_L1: No. I want to be very clear, because it's tempting.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_04_L2: It's a note in a file. It needs a laboratory, months,
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_04_L3: and a ship that can go somewhere. We have none of it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_04_L4: But it tells us what this is made of. That matters.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ARCHIVE_05_L1: I have. She cried, which I am choosing to take well.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_01M_L2: Shepard. The probe's signal. Have you looked yet?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_01_L2: Shepard. Your probe flagged something. Not dilithium.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_02_L1: A holo emitter. A small one, very old. Three hundred
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_02_L2: years, give or take, in a world that shouldn't have
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_02_L3: a holo emitter at all. Somebody left a recording.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_02_O2: Why would anyone do that here?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_03_L1: There's a file on this planet. You'll have heard
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_03_L2: of the Q. Starfleet's view is that one made this place.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_03_L3: A copy of Earth, dropped here, for a joke or a test.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_03_L4: It's the only category they have. It's not a bad one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_04_L1: I believe I'd like to hear the recording.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_04_L2: Bring it to me, off the PADD. Hail me with it on you.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CLUE_04_L3: And don't die with it. It's the only one we know of.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_ALL_L1: That's all six. The whole of him. On the shelf.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_ALL_L3: I'll call you when I've listened. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_EARLY_L1: On the shelf. Out of order, but he numbered them,
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_EARLY_L2: bless him. A historian's dream. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F1_L1: It's a man. Old, recording himself. It's numbered one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F1_L2: He says he was something that doesn't die, once.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F1_L3: Curious about a species that does. I'm dubbing it now.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F2_L1: Number two. He's talking about a woman. Gently.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F2_L2: He says his kind can't love anything. And then he did.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F2_L3: It's going on tape. You'll want to watch this one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F3_L1: Three. It's about her dying. A war over furs.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F3_L2: Fought by people she'd never met, miles away.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F3_L3: I'm putting it on tape. I'm not going to watch it twice.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F4_L1: Four. He copied it. The land, the river, the falls.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F4_L2: And the people. He copied the people. And her.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F4_L3: That's-- I need a minute. It's going on tape.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F5_L1: Five. He gave it up. The power. Made himself mortal
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F5_L2: so he could grow old with her. And he wonders if he
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F5_L3: ever told her what she was. Taping it now.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F6_L1: Six. He's old. Dying, I think. And he's talking to
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F6_L2: whoever found this. To you, I suppose. Not by name.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_F6_L3: He knew the world would outlive them both. Taping it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_FIRSTONE_L1: It'll be on the shelf by the television. One of six,
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_FIRSTONE_L2: he says. The Q file is going to hate this. Or love it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_FIRSTONE_L3: Find the rest if you can. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_HANGT_L1: The television takes tape. So everything goes on tape.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_HANGT_L2: Once it's on the shelf, it can't be lost. Ready?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_HANG_L2: Shepard. You found it? Hold it up to the PADD.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_HANG_L4: Hang on. I can put that on magnetic tape.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_HANG_L5: It's what I've been doing with holos all year.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_LAST_L1: One left. I've been counting days by these.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_MID_L1: That's half of him, near enough, on the shelf.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_MID_L2: Whoever he was, he meant these to be found.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_NONE_L1: I'm not reading one on you. Did you drop it?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_CONVERT_NONE_L2: Hail me again when it's in your hands. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_01M_L2: Okafor. I called once already. I don't usually.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_01Q_L1: Then I'll answer the one you didn't ask.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_01S_L1: Asleep, for once. This is not her conversation.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_01_L2: Commander Okafor. You don't know me. Shepard does.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_01_L3: She tells me you have questions about my employer.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_02_L1: It wasn't us. It wasn't anyone I know of.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_02_L2: We did not disable this ship. We did not do that
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_02_L3: to the county below you. We were as blind as she was.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_03B_L1: Don't, particularly. Believe what the Doctor finds.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_03P_L1: It is. If it were us, I would not be calling you.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_03P_L2: I'd be letting you believe it. It's cheaper.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_03W_L1: Because she will not hear it from me any more.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_03W_L2: And because whoever did this is still out there.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_04P_L1: I can't. There is nothing I could show you that
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_04P_L2: an organisation like mine could not also forge.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_04P_L3: That is the problem with us. We earned it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_04P_O1: Then why should anyone trust you?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_04P_O2: All right. I'll let it go.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_04T_L1: They shouldn't. Believe the evidence, not me.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_04T_L2: The Doctor's reading half a signature. Follow that.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_05_L1: Five months she's been angry at the wrong people.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_05_L2: Somebody left the room before we were blinded,
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_DENIAL_05_L3: and came back for the test. I want to know who.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_01M_L2: Twice now. I'm going to keep calling about this one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_01_L2: Shepard. I want to talk about my people. The eleven.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_02N_L1: Nobody has come up yet. That isn't a complaint.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_02N_L2: Beacons come and go. The shuttle hears them first.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_02R_L1: You've already brought some of them up. %2, last.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_02R_L2: I read the quarantine log every morning. Every name.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03C_L1: Nobody asked you to. Least of all me.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03C_L2: One is a lot more than none. I'll take one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03C_O1: What happens to them up there?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03W_L1: Some can't walk. Some are in a basement with forty
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03W_L2: of the dead on the stairs. Clear ground is a luxury.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03W_O1: What happens to them up there?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03_L1: I don't know. That's the honest answer.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03_L2: Eleven went down. The beacons don't say who's calling.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03_L3: Some are from people I trained. Some I barely knew.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03_L4: Some have stopped, and I don't know which of those
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03_L5: are dead and which just dropped the combadge.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03_O1: What happens to them up there?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_03_O2: Why don't they walk to a clearing?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_04_L1: Quarantine. Showers, blood, the Doctor's bad jokes.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_04_L2: Then a bunk, and a lot of staring at the viewport.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_04_L3: Nobody has turned. Not one. He doesn't know why yet.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_05Y_L1: Yet. You and he would get on.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_05_L1: Keep answering them. The ship pays you for each one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_ELEVEN_05_L2: I pay you in gratitude, which is worth less. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01MM_L2: Third time. I'm going to assume you're busy.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01MM_L3: Or dead. I would rather busy. Answer if you can.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01M_L2: Shuttlecraft, Adirondack. Second time of asking.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01M_L3: I know somebody is down there. The core keeps count.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01M_O1: Sorry. I'm here. Who is this?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01M_O3: Is anyone coming to get us?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01S_L1: Nothing. All right. Then I'll talk, and you listen.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01S_L2: If you're hurt, or scared, that is fine. Just listen.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01_L2: Shuttlecraft, this is the Adirondack. Please respond.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01_L3: Somebody has been aboard my shuttle. The core says so.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01_L4: If you can hear me, say something. Anything at all.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01_O1: I hear you. Who is this?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_01_O3: Is anyone coming to get us?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02H_L1: No. I'm sorry. Nobody is coming. Not for years.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02H_L2: I'd rather tell you that now than have you hope.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02R_L1: Ha. No. Mine. Logged item by item, every lamp.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02R_L2: But you're alive and you found her, so she's yours now.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02R_L3: Look after her. She's the only one left down there.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02_L1: Lieutenant Lucy Shepard. Cultural survey. And that
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02_L2: is my shuttle you're standing in. My fridge, my oven.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02_L3: My chair, which I would quite like back one day.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02_L4: I have talked to the same hundred and forty faces
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_02_L5: since July. You are the first new voice in months.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_03J_L1: You know what happened in July. You're living in it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_03J_L2: I meant up here. It's been a long summer in orbit.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_03_L1: So. Who am I talking to?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_03_O1: I'm from around here. I found this in a field.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_03_O3: My name's %1. That's all you get.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04N_L1: A local. Of course you are. Of course you are.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04N_L2: Then I owe you an apology, and it is a very big one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04N_L3: We were up here watching when it happened to you.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04N_L4: We watched, and we wrote it down, and we did nothing.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04Q_L1: Nothing? All right. I'll call you the shuttle, then.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04Q_L2: Plenty of people up here I'd rather not know better.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04S_L2: Nobody told me. Nobody told any of us anything.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04S_L3: I'll take it. I'm not in any position to check.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04S_L4: And frankly, I've stopped caring whose side anyone is on.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_04X_L1: Fair. I wouldn't tell me either, after this summer.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_05_L1: Three things, and then you can hang up on me.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_05_L2: One. I'm alive. So are a hundred and forty others.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_05_L3: Two. The Adirondack cannot leave. No warp. No impulse.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_05_L4: Three. We can still transport. That is what we kept.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_05_O2: Then get me out of here.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_05_O3: Why tell me any of this?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06Q_L1: You shouldn't. I'm not going to pretend otherwise.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06Q_L2: The ship pays for it. Patterns for the replicator,
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06Q_L3: supplies. And they would do it for you. Every one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06U_L1: I would. I can't. Not yet, and it isn't my call.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06U_L2: The Doctor won't bring anyone up from the surface
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06U_L3: until he knows how it spreads. Quarantine. Hard stop.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06U_L4: I'm sorry. I know exactly what I'm asking you to live in.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06W_L1: Because you're in my shuttle, and my shuttle works.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06W_L2: And because there are people down there who are mine.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06_L1: Eleven of my crew stayed on the ground. For the work.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06_L2: Some of them are still calling. Distress beacons.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06_L3: Your shuttle hears them. I can't find them without you.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06_L4: Get to one, call it in, and we pull them up from here.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06_O1: I'll see what I can do.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_06_O2: Why should I risk my neck for your people?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_07A_L1: Then you know more than Starfleet does.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_07A_L2: That's a low bar. I'm sorry you had to clear it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_07A_L3: And you know about the chair. Don't sit in it for me.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_07_L1: One more thing, and it's the one that matters to me.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_07_L2: The tapes by the television. They're mine. Watch them.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_07_L3: Everything I know about what happened is on those.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_08_L1: I'll call again. Or you call me, off your PADD.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_FIRST_08_L2: Most of the time nobody answers up here. Try anyway.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_01M_L2: Shepard. When you have a minute. About the six.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_01_L2: Shepard. I've watched them. All six. Twice.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_02Q_L1: I'm writing it up. I'm not going to write it that way.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_02Q_L2: I'm going to write what he said. They can decide.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_02_L1: His name was Tucker Gold. The name he chose, when he
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_02_L2: stopped being what he was. That's in number five.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_02_L3: There's a case like him on file. Rana Four. A Douwd.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_02_L4: Beings that can make a world out of grief. Or end one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_02_O1: He made all this? The whole county?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_03_L1: The land and the river, and the people on it. Then
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_03_L2: he put it down and grew old with her, and the towns
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_03_L3: grew on their own for three hundred years.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_03_L4: Your parents were real. Your town was real. Is.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_04_L1: It's real either way. That's the only line I'd hold.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_04_L2: The place was made. The people weren't. Nobody made you.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GOLD_04_L3: Thank you for bringing him in. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_01M_L2: Shepard. No emergency. When you've got a second.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_01_L2: Shepard. Nothing's wrong. I just want to say a thing
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_01_L3: out loud to somebody who'll understand it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_02_L1: A Douwd made this county because he couldn't bear
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_02_L2: one death. A Changeling is emptying it because it
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_02_L3: couldn't bear a genocide. Made by grief, and unmade.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_02_L4: Both of them the last of something. Both alone.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_03E_L1: No. It explains it. That's all I'm good for.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_03_L1: We're the ones who aren't alone. That's the difference.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_03_L2: A hundred and forty up here. You down there.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_03_L3: The ones you've brought up. We have each other.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_GRIEF_03_L4: It's not a plan. It's just true. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_LOST_01_L2: It's Shepard. %2's beacon stopped an hour ago.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_LOST_01_L3: I'm not calling to blame you. I'm calling so someone
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_LOST_01_L4: hears the name out loud. That's all.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_LOST_02_L1: I know. Nobody could. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_LOST_03_L1: There will. That's the worst thing anyone's said today.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_QUIET_01_L2: Adirondack. Shepard. Everything all right down there?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_QUIET_01_O1: I want you to stop calling.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_QUIET_02_L2: All right. I can do that.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_QUIET_02_L3: The shuttle will still hear the beacons. That's hers.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_QUIET_02_L4: If you ever want me, hail. I'll pick up if I can.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_RESUME_02_L1: I will, then. Sparingly. I promise.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_RESUME_03_L1: Still here. Still going nowhere. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_01M_L2: Shepard. Please pick up. This is the one that matters.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_01_L2: Shepard. Are you somewhere you can sit down?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_02_L1: We put the pieces together. Okafor, the Doctor, me.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_02_L2: The Founders' virus. Borg nanoprobes. One engine.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_02_L3: A Changeling left the Great Link, years ago, on purpose.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_02_L4: It knew what Section 31 did to its people. The virus.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_02_L5: And it spent sixty years making that into this.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_02_O1: I know. It's on your last tape.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_03T_L1: Then you know I left the chair where it was. Good.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_03T_L2: What the tape doesn't have is the part that's next.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_03_L1: One. Alone. That's the part I can't get past.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_03_L2: One person, grieving for long enough, did all of it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_04_L1: Because nobody was watching. Nothing filed. No relay.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_04_L2: An order saying do not interfere. The Prime Directive
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_04_L3: is what left this world undefended. I helped write it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_04_L4: And because your world is the closest thing to Earth
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_04_L5: anybody has ever found. It's a rehearsal.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_05_L1: For the Federation. The worlds that did this to it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_05_L2: A horde is a Collective with no Queen, and nobody at
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_05_L3: home knows it exists. We can't warn them. Comms dark.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_05_O1: Then we have to get word out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_05_O2: What do you want me to do?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_06N_L1: No. It's the one that watched you die and took notes.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_06N_L2: You don't owe it anything. I'm not going to ask.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_06_L1: Stay alive. Bring my people up. Keep the tapes.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_06_L2: If a ship ever does come, I want the whole record.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_06_L3: Not a report. A record. Everything, in order.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_REVEAL_Title: The one who left the Link
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_01M_L2: I did say they wouldn't pick up. I said it twice.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_01M_L3: You did. Shuttle, have you got a moment?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_01_L2: Shepard. I've got the Doctor with me. Ours.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_01_L3: Good afternoon. Or whatever it is on the surface.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_01_O2: Is this going to be bad news?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_02E_L1: Your shuttle's hologram has been sending me readings.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_02E_L2: Sensibly formatted, which I did not expect from a
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_02E_L3: copy of myself. I suppose I should be flattered.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_02S_L1: The crew you've sent up brought samples on their boots.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_02S_L2: Accidentally. I have made the most of them.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_03P_L1: Two different things did this. I can see one of them.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_03P_L2: The other is a shape in the dark where one should be.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_03_L1: The dead down there are not dead in the usual way.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_03_L2: Something rebuilt them. Morphogenic markers, yes --
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_03_L3: the Founders' own chemistry, which is bad enough.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_03_L4: But there's a second signature underneath it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_03_L5: Something is holding the tissue together. Running it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04M_L1: It matters to me. It'll matter to whoever gets home.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04M_L2: It matters to a cure. Which is my department.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04W_L1: I think it is two people who never met. One made
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04W_L2: the poison and one made the engine. Don't quote me.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04_L1: I don't know. That's the sentence I dislike most.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04_L2: I can support the chemistry. I cannot support the author.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04_L3: He keeps saying that. It still sounds like Section 31.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04_L4: It sounds like whoever you have already decided on.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_04_O2: Who do you think it is?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_05_L1: The living, if they're caught early? Your shuttle
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_05_L2: does that already, at a price. The dead? No.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_05_L3: I'm sorry. I would like to be wrong about that.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_SCIENCE_05_L4: Thank you, Doctor. Shuttle, Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_01M_L2: I tried you yesterday. I'll assume the dead were busy.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_01M_L3: Have you got a minute now?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_01_L2: Shepard. Have you got a minute? A real one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_02X_L1: I owe the ten who stayed because I did. You'll do.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_02_L1: Something you asked, or didn't. Why I stayed down.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_02_L2: February to July, on the ground, with a ship overhead
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_02_L3: begging me to come up. I owe somebody the answer.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_02_O3: I figured it was the work.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_03_L1: Because it was the best work anybody in my field
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_03_L2: will ever get to do. A living world, unannounced.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_03_L3: And because I could pass. Six months of market days.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_03_L4: The others could sit in orbit and read my notes.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_03_L5: Ten of them didn't. They came down because I did.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04A_L1: That's kind. It's also not how command works.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04A_L2: A lieutenant who plants a flag is a place to stand.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04A_L3: I knew that. I planted it anyway.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04A_O1: Then you'd better start carrying it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04BS_L1: It was fair. Cruel and fair aren't opposites.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04BT_L1: It is. I'll be carrying it a long time.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04BT_L2: You don't have to carry it with me. That's all.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04B_L2: Some of them. Yes. Say it again if it helps you.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04B_L3: It doesn't help me, but I'm not the one down there.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04C_L1: Knowing what I know now? No.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04C_L2: Knowing what I knew then? Yes. Every time.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_04C_L3: That's the whole problem with being a historian.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_05_L1: They've asked me to ask you to come up. For the file.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_05_L2: I told them it's quarantine and you'd say no anyway.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_05_L3: Would you? If the Doctor cleared it?
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_05_O2: No. Somebody has to stay down here.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_05_O3: Ask me when he's cleared it.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_06L_L1: Fair. I'll ask. He'll say not yet. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_06N_L2: Now you know why I stayed. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_06Y_L1: Then I hope he's quick. I really do.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_STAY_06Y_L2: Until then the beacons are yours. Shepard out.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_THANKS_01_L2: It's Shepard. %2 is aboard. In quarantine, but aboard.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_THANKS_02_L1: Thin. Filthy. Asked for coffee before a blanket.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_THANKS_02_L2: The Doctor says that's a good sign. I think he's lying.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_THANKS_02_O1: Tell them they owe me one.
Print_Text_TREK_COMM_THANKS_03_L1: I'll tell them. Thank you. Really. Shepard out.
